competitive_landscape: Inter-island air (Mokulele to Lānaʻi / Molokaʻi) and the slow Expeditions ferry serve the county today — both demand evidence. There is no inter-island ferry to Molokaʻi or across ʻAlenuihāhā, leaving open lanes. Humpback season (Dec–Apr) imposes speed restrictions all operators share.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II is ideal for Maui County: the Lānaʻi (~9 nm), Molokaʻi (~8 nm) and ʻAlenuihāhā-to-Hawaiʻi-Island (~30 nm) crossings, plus the south-Maui resort shuttle, are all comfortably in all-electric range.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) carries the line-haul to Honolulu (~75 nm) with no charging dependency.

precedents.why_it_matters: Demonstrates resort-anchored on-demand water transfer with concentrated luxury demand — the Maui-County resort cluster mirrors it.

regulatory_note: Hawaii environmental review (HEPA) and the Superferry precedent shape inter-island service; a zero-emission, low-wake foiling profile is the answer. US Coast Guard Subchapter T applies; Lahaina is rebuilding post-2023 fire and harbor access is being restored.
seasonality: Year-round resort demand; the ʻAuʻau and Pailolo channels are sheltered most of the year, while ʻAlenuihāhā is reliably rough — exactly where the foiling comfort advantage is most visible. Whale season (Dec–Apr) requires careful operating profiles.
signature_routes: Maui ↔ Hawaiʻi Island / ʻAlenuihāhā (Pioneer II, ~30 nm)
summary: Maui County spans three islands separated by short, sheltered-then-rough channels: Maui's resort coasts (Lahaina, Kāʻanapali, Wailea), Lānaʻi (privately held, home to Four Seasons Lānaʻi at Manele Bay), and quiet Molokaʻi. The Maui↔Lānaʻi (~9 nm) and Maui↔Molokaʻi (~8 nm) hops sit inside Pioneer II all-electric range and run today on slow ferries and small craft; the ʻAuʻau Channel to Lānaʻi is one of the most sheltered, whale-rich stretches in Hawaii. Across the county's eastern edge lies ʻAlenuihāhā — the channel to Hawaiʻi Island, among the roughest open water on Earth — where a foiling ride that cancels the chop is the single strongest seasickness-relief story Navier has anywhere.
tagline: The luxury heart of Hawaii — Four Seasons Lānaʻi, the Wailea resort coast, and the short sheltered channels made for all-electric foiling.
